appName.message: Colonist Card Tracker – 卡坦卡牌计数器
appName.description: Store name. Must start with the brand 'Colonist Card Tracker'; after a dash, a short local phrase meaning 'Catan card counter'. Web Store shows about 35 characters in search results and recommends 45 at most.

appDesc.message: colonist.io 卡坦卡牌计数器：抢夺概率、银行、发展卡与骰子。以匿名方式记录对局用于研究。
appDesc.description: Short description shown by Chrome and as the Web Store summary. HARD LIMIT 132 characters. Keep 'Catan', 'card counter' and 'colonist.io' near the start.

rateAsk.description: Footer link shown after the third finished game, once: invitation to rate the extension in the Web Store. Friendly, no pressure, no reward.

rateDismiss.description: Tooltip of the small × next to rateAsk: dismisses the invitation for good.

title.description: Panel title, next to a card emoji. Keep short.

waiting.description: Status shown while no game is loaded.

waitingHint.message: 加入一局游戏。如果你已在对局中，请刷新页面（F5）以获取当前状态。
waitingHint.description: Hint under the waiting status. F5 is the reload key.

spectator.description: Status chip when the user is watching, not playing. Lowercase if the language allows.

turn.description: Prefix before the turn number, e.g. 'turn 12'.

bank.description: Row label for the bank's cards. Use the same word colonist.io uses in this language.

you.description: Small tag after the user's own name: '(you)'.

bot.description: Tooltip on the robot icon next to computer players.

dice.description: Section title for the dice histogram.

steals.description: Footer: number of steals whose card was not visible, e.g. '3 hidden steals'.

scenarios.description: Footer: number of possible worlds being tracked, e.g. '120 scenarios'.

approx.description: Footer suffix in parentheses when the scenario count was capped.

synced.description: Tooltip on the green check next to a player's total.

desync.description: Tooltip on the red exclamation mark next to a player's total.

total.description: Column header for the total. The sigma symbol is fine in every language; change only if it reads badly.

totalTitle.description: Tooltip of the total column header.

contradictions.description: Tooltip of the warning triangle in the footer.

knights.description: Tooltip fragment after a number: '2 knights played'.

expVP.description: Tooltip fragment before a number: 'expected VP 0.4'. VP = victory points; use the local abbreviation if one exists.

unknownCol.description: Tooltip of the '?' column (cards of unknown type).

modeRange.message: 显示范围（最少 + 可能的额外数量）
modeRange.description: Tooltip of the % button when the panel shows expected values (click switches to range mode).

modeExpected.description: Tooltip of the % button when the panel shows ranges (click switches to expected values).

close.message: 隐藏（按 Alt+Shift+C 重新显示）
close.description: Tooltip of the × button. Keep the key combination Alt+Shift+C literally.

rec.description: Blinking recording indicator, like on a camera. Keep 'REC' unless the language has a common alternative.

recTitle.message: 正在（匿名）记录本局用于研究

consentTitle.description: Heading of the consent card shown before the counter works.

consentText.message: 本扩展免费。作为交换，它会以匿名方式保存对局历史（操作、交易和聊天）：所有玩家名称在任何数据离开你的浏览器之前都会被替换为代码。数据仅用于研究游戏中的决策与谈判。使用计数器需要你的同意。
consentText.description: LEGAL TEXT. Translate faithfully, do not shorten: it says the extension is free, that it stores game history (moves, trades and chat) anonymously, that names are replaced by codes before anything leaves the browser, that data is collected exclusively for research on decision-making and negotiation in the game, and that accepting is required to use the counter.

consentYes.description: Primary button of the consent card.

consentNo.description: Secondary button of the consent card.

consentMore.description: Link that opens the options page.

consentDeclined.message: 由于你未同意匿名数据收集，计数器已停用。你可以随时同意。
consentDeclined.description: Text shown instead of consentText after the user declined.

resLumber.description: Resource tooltip. Use the exact word colonist.io shows in this language for the wood resource.

resCloth.description: Cities & Knights commodity, as in colonist.io.

resCoin.description: Cities & Knights commodity, as in colonist.io.

resPaper.description: Cities & Knights commodity, as in colonist.io.

devKnight.description: 1-3 character abbreviation of 'Knight' shown in the played-cards list.

researchTitle.description: Options page: heading of the consent section.

researchText.message: 本扩展会保存你在 colonist.io 上每一局的历史（操作、交易、骰子和聊天），并在对局结束时上传到项目服务器。在任何数据离开你的浏览器之前，所有用户名和标识符（你和其他玩家的）都会被替换为由仅存在于你本地安装中的随机密钥生成的代码；头像、邮箱和令牌会被移除。所有信息均为匿名，且仅用于研究游戏中的决策与谈判。使用计数器需要你的同意。
researchText.description: LEGAL TEXT, options page. Longer version of consentText; translate faithfully and completely.

optConsentYes.message: 我同意：记录并上传我的匿名对局

optConsentNo.message: 我不同意（计数器保持停用）

installId.description: Label before the random installation identifier.

privacy.description: Link text to the privacy policy.

serverTitle.description: Options page: heading of the server section (advanced users).

endpoint.description: Label of the server URL field.

token.description: Label of the optional token field.

saved.description: Confirmation shown for two seconds after saving.

keepLocal.message: 为每局已上传的对局保留本地副本

gamesTitle.description: Options page: heading of the recorded games table.

deleteAllConfirm.message: 删除本地保存的全部对局？已上传的对局不会从服务器删除。
deleteAllConfirm.description: Browser confirm() dialog before deleting local data.

colFrames.description: Table column header: number of network messages recorded.

empty.description: Shown when the table is empty.

partial.description: Small tag after a game id when the recording did not capture the whole game.

status_pending.description: Row status: waiting to be uploaded.

status_failed.description: Row status: upload failed after retries.

status_local.description: Row status: kept locally because no server is configured.
